comments.quoteEn: The family are welcoming. There is a stream at the door, handy for playing in the water, and their puppy is adorable. The place smells of sunshine. The towels are single use, so no worries there, and the tissues and toilet roll were all newly opened.

comments.quote: 房間很大，也很乾凈。老闆娘很熱情。庭院裏有秋千、躺椅。門口就有玩水、游泳的地方，離魚鱗壩也很近，步行8分鐘左右。適合家庭出遊。
comments.author: Bushibianjie
